Top 50 Active Subverses in the last week; /v/whatever topping the list as per usual (I can see this segment getting repetitive already).

Voat Updates

There does not seem to be any (visible) news with respect to Voat updates. Voat Banlog

No users were banned last week.

No domains were banned last week.
